verdict.rationale: New Relic documents a NerdGraph API explorer for experimenting with its GraphQL API, which is an interactive way to run API calls. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and doesn't show a full API reference with runnable examples. No OpenAPI spec was found at the probed paths, which is less relevant for a GraphQL API. Missing for 10: documented interactive reference coverage across the API surface, explicit runnable example queries in the reference, independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: An easy way to experiment with the NerdGraph API is to use the NerdGraph API explorer.
NerdGraph is our GraphQL-format API that lets you query New Relic data and configure some New Relic features.
